button.label: Add Input
button.supertip: Insert a probability distribution function into the selected cell. Choose from 25+ distributions including Normal, Triangular, PERT, Lognormal, Beta, Gamma, Weibull, and more.

button.label: Add Output
button.supertip: Mark the selected cell as a simulation output. Output cells are tracked during simulation and their values are collected for statistical analysis.

button.label: Correlations
button.supertip: Define Spearman rank correlations between input distributions. Correlations ensure that related uncertain variables move together during simulation.

button.label: Model Window
button.supertip: View all defined inputs, outputs, and correlations in the current workbook.

button.label: Run
button.supertip: Start Monte Carlo simulation with current settings. The simulation will iterate through all defined inputs and collect output values.

button.label: Pause
button.supertip: Pause or resume the running simulation.

button.label: Stop
button.supertip: Stop the simulation. Partial results will be available.

button.label: Settings
button.supertip: Configure simulation parameters: number of iterations, sampling method (Monte Carlo or Latin Hypercube), random seed, convergence monitoring, and more.

button.label: Browse Results
button.supertip: Open the results browser to view statistics, percentiles, and iteration data for each output.

button.label: Charts
button.supertip: Generate histograms, cumulative distribution charts, overlay charts, tornado diagrams, spider plots, and scatter plots.

button.label: Sensitivity
button.supertip: Run sensitivity analysis using regression, rank correlation, or contribution to variance methods. Generate tornado and spider charts.

button.label: Statistics
button.supertip: Generate a detailed statistics report for all outputs including mean, std dev, percentiles, skewness, and kurtosis.

button.label: Export Data
button.supertip: Export all iteration data to a new worksheet for further analysis.

button.label: Reset
button.supertip: Clear all simulation results and reset to initial state.
